$comment: Every skipped test, and why (tooling/quarantine.mjs, docs/testing.md § Known sources of noise). A flaky test gets an issue and an until at most 14 days ahead; a test not meant to run in the suite gets a reason.

tests.name: write_the_fixture
tests.reason: Writes api/fixtures/mls-framing.json when the framing changes; run by hand with --ignored.

tests.name: devices_talk_through_the_worker
tests.reason: Needs cf dev --mode interop; interop.yml runs it with --ignored.

tests.name: a_browser_session_links_to_a_phone_through_the_worker
tests.reason: Needs cf dev --mode interop; interop.yml runs it with --ignored.

tests.name: a_phone_links_a_real_browser
tests.reason: The phone's half of web/e2e/chat.spec.ts and web/e2e/suspension.spec.ts; interop.yml runs it through those specs, with SPJALL_BROWSER_DIR.

tests.name: a phone links this browser, which shows the phone's message and replies
tests.reason: Needs cf dev --mode interop and the phone's half in core/; interop.yml runs it with SPJALL_BROWSER_PHONE.

tests.name: a_browser_manages_a_group
tests.reason: The phone's half of web/e2e/group.spec.ts; interop.yml runs it through that spec, with SPJALL_BROWSER_DIR.

tests.name: a browser adds a person, removes a member, names a group and leaves it
tests.reason: Needs cf dev --mode interop and the phone's half in core/; interop.yml runs it with SPJALL_BROWSER_PHONE.

tests.name: a suspended account's conversation has no notice, and its composer stays in the viewport
tests.reason: Needs cf dev --mode interop and the phone's half in core/; interop.yml runs it with SPJALL_BROWSER_PHONE.
